full_judgment:
4. The petitioner as the plaintiff instituted Other Suit No. 75 of 1987 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Roumari, for declaration of title in respect of 1.18 acres of land out of a portion of land appertaining to plot Nos. 4441, 4442, 4443, 4445, 4472. His case, in short, is that the suit land belonged to Jamal Sheikh and the heirs of Jamal Sheikh sold the suit land by two registered deeds of sale dated 26-6-1986 in favour of the plaintiff. The SA record was prepared in the names of the defendants. The plaintiff's further case is that he got his homestead on the land of plot No. 4472. For the wrong recording of the suit land in SA khatian, the plaintiff's title became cloudy and hence the suit has been filed for declaration of title in the suit land. 

 "It appears that out of 5 plots of land the plaintiffs have prayed for declaration of title upon 1.18 acres of land without specifying any boundary and without giving any sketch map. It further appears that the plaintiff failed to produce the SA Khatian. The CS Khatian has been submitted. It appears from the CS Khatian that the suit land has been recorded in a number of plots measuring an area of 2.36 acres out of which the plaintiff sought for declaration to 1.18 acres of land without specifying any boundary or sketch map."
